formats.name: HF safetensors BF16/FP16 (the source)
formats.when_to_choose: Always keep it (or its pinned commit) as the master for every quant, fine-tune and merge. Serve it only for small models that fit.
formats.quality_notes: Reference quality; every KLD is measured against it (or against Q8_0 when BF16 does not fit, recorded). Disk 2 bytes/param.
formats.owner_note: Many owner quants have no surviving BF16 source; re-download by pinned commit before re-quantising or fine-tuning.

formats.name: GGUF BF16/F16 master
formats.when_to_choose: The input for every GGUF quant, imatrix and llama.cpp KLD baseline. Can be pruned after the ladder (re-converts in minutes from the HF master).
formats.quality_notes: Lossless vs the BF16 safetensors; norms stay F32 (measured 30 BF16 + 9 F32).

formats.name: GGUF K-quants (Q2_K, Q3_K_S/M/L, Q4_K_S/M, Q5_K_S/M, Q6_K) and Q8_0
formats.bits: Llama-3.1-8B (llama.cpp README): Q2_K 3.16, Q3_K_M 4.00, Q4_K_M 4.89, Q5_K_M 5.70, Q6_K 6.56, Q8_0 8.50 bpw
formats.when_to_choose: The default for anything that must mix GPU and CPU (big MoE with experts in RAM, very long context with partial offload) and for Ollama users. Q4_K_M or Q5_K_M is the novice default; Q6_K/Q8_0 when it fits.
formats.quality_notes: Q8_0 near lossless, Q6_K nearly so. Upstream PPL deltas at 8B: Q4_K_M +0.175, Q5_K_M +0.057, Q6_K +0.022, Q8_0 +0.003. An imatrix can improve K-quants too (Q4_K_M KLD 0.00172 -> 0.00157 on one tiny model) but must be A/B tested (it made Q4_K_M slightly worse with a 1,664-token calibration set).

formats.name: GGUF IQ-quants (IQ1_S/M, IQ2_XXS/XS/S/M, IQ3_XXS/XS/S/M, IQ4_XS/NL), TQ1_0/TQ2_0, Q1_0/Q2_0
formats.when_to_choose: Squeezing models that would not otherwise fit (100B+ MoE on 48 GB VRAM + 64 GB RAM); IQ4_XS as a smaller alternative to Q4_K_M.
formats.quality_notes: IQ1_*, IQ2_XXS/XS/S, IQ3_XXS and Q2_K_S fail without an imatrix (verified). Quantising is 2-12x slower than Q4_K_M (measured). On a tiny model IQ2_M (3.14 bpw) beat Q2_K (3.36 bpw): KLD 0.0069 vs 0.019. IQ4_XS changed a greedy tool-call argument that Q4_K_M kept, despite KLD 0.0012: always run the behaviour probes.

formats.name: GGUF MXFP4_MOE (and gpt-oss native MXFP4 in GGUF)
formats.bits: experts MXFP4 (~4.25 bpw), other tensors Q8_0 (verified type mix)
formats.when_to_choose: MoE models whose experts dominate the size; gpt-oss is already MXFP4, so convert it without re-quantising. On 48 GB, llama.cpp with some experts in RAM (--n-cpu-moe) is the practical way to run gpt-oss-120b.
formats.quality_notes: The converter repacks gpt-oss MXFP4 experts losslessly. Quantising other MoEs to MXFP4 is RTN-like: measure KLD against Q4_K_M+imatrix.

formats.name: EXL3 (ExLlamaV3, QTIP-based trellis)
formats.bits: any fractional target about 1-8 bpw (-b), head 6 by default (-hb), -hq promotion for MoE, embeddings optionally quantised (-eb)
formats.when_to_choose: The model plus KV fits entirely in the 48 GB of VRAM and you want the fastest single-user speed with tensor parallel across both 3090s (the owner sees about 100 tok/s), with quantised KV (cache_mode k,v bits 2-8). The replacement for EXL2.
formats.quality_notes: Upstream shows lower KLD than GGUF at equal VRAM. eval/ppl.py -g gives llama.cpp-comparable PPL; model_diff.py gives KLD and top-K agreement; -cqs sweeps KV bits. An optimised-recipe path exists (experimental). CUDA only to make and load: unverified here.

formats.name: EXL2 (legacy, ExLlamaV2)
formats.when_to_choose: Only to keep existing EXL2 files working on the pinned older TabbyAPI until they are re-made as EXL3 from the BF16 source.
formats.quality_notes: measurement.json reuse makes a ladder cheap, but current TabbyAPI refuses to load EXL2 (message reproduced). Compare the EXL3 replacement's KLD on the same reference before switching.
formats.owner_note: Upgrading TabbyAPI silently breaks every EXL2 the owner serves: track it as a housekeeping commitment.

formats.name: compressed-tensors W4A16 (GPTQ or AWQ via llm-compressor) and other AWQ
formats.bits: 4-bit int, group 128 (+ scales) ≈ 4.25 bpw on linear layers; embeddings/lm_head kept 16-bit
served_by: vLLM (Marlin kernels on Ampere: awq_marlin, gptq_marlin, compressed-tensors)
formats.when_to_choose: Multi-user or batch serving on vLLM, where throughput under concurrency and prefix caching matter more than single-stream speed.
formats.quality_notes: Tiny model: mean KLD 0.00017 (GPTQ). AWQ quantisation needs CUDA in llmcompressor 0.14.0; AutoAWQ is deprecated.

formats.name: GPTQ (GPTQModel format gptq / gptq_v2 / marlin)
formats.when_to_choose: Interop with GPTQ ecosystems, per-module dynamic bits, resumable long jobs. NOT for current TabbyAPI.
formats.quality_notes: Same KLD as llm-compressor GPTQ on the tiny model (0.00017); quant_log.csv gives per-module loss for gating.

formats.name: FP8 (FP8_DYNAMIC per-channel/per-token, FP8_BLOCK 128x128) compressed-tensors
formats.bits: 8-bit float weights + per-channel or per-block scales
served_by: vLLM (on RTX 3090 as weight-only W8A16 via FP8 Marlin; min capability 7.5)
formats.when_to_choose: Fast, data-free, near-lossless 8-bit for vLLM; model_free_ptq handles models with no transformers class. On Ampere no faster than 8-bit integer formats.
formats.quality_notes: Tiny model KLD 0.00042. W8A8 FP8 compute needs SM >= 8.9 (Ada/Hopper).

formats.name: MXFP4A16 / NVFP4A16 (weight-only FP4) and W4A4 MXFP4/NVFP4
formats.bits: 4-bit float, group 32 (MX, E8M0 scale) or 16 (NV, FP8 scale + global scale)
served_by: vLLM (mxfp4 min capability 8.0; Marlin FP4 listed for Ampere; not verified on a 3090)
formats.when_to_choose: Weight-only FP4 for vLLM on Ampere. W4A4 variants only on hardware with FP4 activations (Blackwell class).
formats.quality_notes: Tiny model: NVFP4A16 KLD 0.00064; W4A4 MXFP4 0.0085 (13x worse).

formats.name: gpt-oss native MXFP4 safetensors
served_by: vLLM (mxfp4 / gpt_oss_mxfp4, Marlin on Ampere; tool parser 'openai')
formats.when_to_choose: gpt-oss-120b/20b as published; never re-quantise it.
formats.quality_notes: The native training format, so no extra quantisation loss. TabbyAPI auto-detects the Harmony format.

formats.name: bitsandbytes NF4 (including Unsloth merged-4bit)
formats.when_to_choose: QLoRA fine-tuning bases and quick experiments; not a fast serving format; never a source for EXL3/GGUF quants.
formats.quality_notes: Tiny model KLD 0.00062 with no calibration.

formats.name: HQQ
formats.when_to_choose: Fast data-free low-bit experiments only; not a serving format for this stack (absent from vLLM 0.32's method list).
formats.quality_notes: Calibration-free; HQQ+ adds low-rank adapters for low bits. Not measured for KLD here.

formats.name: PEFT LoRA adapter (adapter_model.safetensors + adapter_config.json)
formats.when_to_choose: Ship or try a fine-tune without a full model copy, swap skills per request, or archive several skills over one base. 77.8 KB at r=8 on the fixture; about 87 MB estimated at r=16 for 8B.

formats.name: GGUF LoRA adapter

quality.class_rule: The class is the nominal bits of the planned type (GGUF type name table; EXL3 floor(bits) clamped to 2..8 with >= 7.5 -> 8; HF formats by scheme), not the measured bpw, because tiny or narrow models inflate measured bpw.

quality.p99_rule: max_p99_kld = 12 x max_mean_kld (the 4-bit pair 0.05 / 0.6 proposed in the quantise research); an assumption to calibrate.
quality.ppl_rule: PPL ratio is secondary and report-only at 3 bits and below (max_ppl_ratio null).
quality.ladder_rule: Within one family (K or IQ), a higher-bpw quant must not have a mean KLD more than 10% above a lower-bpw one.
quality.imatrix_rule: An imatrix variant must not be worse than the same type without imatrix; if it is, flag the calibration set (warn, not fail).
quality.kv_rule: Gate the KV-cache type the server will actually run (llama.cpp -ctk/-ctv, TabbyAPI cache_mode).
quality.reference_rule: Reference = BF16, or Q8_0 when BF16 does not fit VRAM+RAM (recorded in the manifest).

gate_lessons: Test reachability of huggingface.co and download.pytorch.org first and stop with a plain message; never fall back silently to mirrors.
Record the git sha, not the build number (shallow clones say 'build 1').
llama-server's web UI is fetched from huggingface.co at build time; offline it embeds 0 assets.
Convert gate: exit 0, file present, no 'BPE pre-tokenizer was not recognized'/chkhsh; surface the chkhsh.
GGUF metadata gate: chat_template present, eos = chat end token, add_bos matches the source, context length as expected.
Template parity: served /apply-template must byte-match the HF rendering.
imatrix sanity: record chunks x ctx and entries; 'did not find weights for token_embd.weight' is expected with tied embeddings.
A/B the imatrix against a no-imatrix control by KLD.
Parse fallback-quantisation warnings and label variants by measured BPW.
Rank by KLD, not PPL; run an f16 self-KLD sanity check.
Budget disk for the KLD base before running it; cap chunks; delete it afterwards.
llama-perplexity needs at least 2 x n_ctx tokens; one KLD run per quant gives PPL(Q) too.
Tool-call gate: name offered, JSON parses, schema-valid, values right, no markup without tools, round trip answers, finish_reason tool_calls.
Behaviour diff vs f16 at temperature 0 catches divergence KLD hides (IQ4_XS).
Benchmarks: record load average, threads and build_commit; -r >= 10; reject CV > ~10%.
Hash everything (HF files, each GGUF, the imatrix) and store with licence and recipe.
